# Area Owners

## All Areas

- **Keywords**: issue, bug, regression, error, failure, feature, enhancement, request, question, documentation, configuration, deployment, workflow, agent, skill, GitHub, Foundry
- **Paths**: **/*
- **Owners**: @chagong

## Assignment Policy

Assign every issue in this repository to `@chagong`. If an issue does not match
any keyword or mention a file path, use `@chagong` as the default owner.
